title: "O10 Develop reporting guidelines"
link-citations: true

Terminology: minimal reporting standards, reporting checklists

## Definition
These studies aim to develop guidance that helps health researchers or other interest-holders report methods, typically as a checklist with explanations. The development process may combine multiple methods research approaches.

## Typical approaches and corresponding examples
[Consensus studies](../approaches/8consensus.qmd): Delphi study to develop CONSORT reporting guideline.[@Hopewell2025consort]

[Reviews of applied or planned methods](../approaches/9review-applied.qmd): review of observational studies emulating a target trial to inform the TARGET reporting guideline.[@Cashin2025transparent]

[Scoping reviews of methods research](../approaches/11scoping-review.qmd): a scoping review informed the development of a new reporting guideline for factorial trials.[@Kahan2023reporting]

## Guidance
- Guidance for understanding and applying methods: Moher 2010[@Moher2010guidance]
- Guidance for reporting methods: None identified
- Guidance for assessing methods: None identified
